scope: Actual styled Status, machine panel/session, raw editor, router and API with synthetic HTTP. No real backend validation/publication, machine execution, native TUI, CI or deployment.
checks: file and last observed server activity are separate
open and toggle make no writes
preview refusal preserves the draft and does not write
CAS conflict preserves file and draft
explicit reapply/save preserves inline TOML, comments, DOS and concurrent edits
raw draft is retained with its stale write basis withdrawn
lost commit reply triggers readback, retains uncertainty, and never repeats the write
independent MSX/DOS changes do not load or restore a machine
failed observation is visible and explicitly recoverable
mobile controls remain visible without horizontal overflow
only explicit previews/saves: no model resume, machine action, unexpected route or page error
